newsitem.title: MEXICO: FORECAST-Mexico 28-day Cetes seen rising slightly.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Mexico 28-day Cetes seen rising slightly.

text.p: Interest rates on Mexico's bellwether 28-day Cetes, or T-bills, are seen rising 18 basis points to 21.08 percent, but rates are seen falling at longer terms at this week's primary auction, according to a Reuters' survey of nine Cetes dealers.
Following is a table comparing last week's primary rates versus expectations for this week's auction and the expected change in basis points.
